selection_rule: First eligible decision in the original formal Host episode for a long request with already generated output; selected before the new one-event experiment, not by observed best action.
hash_encoding: sha256(json.dumps(list(all_known_token_ids)).encode()) with standard json.dumps separators; prompt plus already generated tokens only.
online_contract: Only external identity, preemption ordinal, current known/generated counts and current prefix hash must match. Native positive ready Host hit and full joint GPU capacity are also required. Other decisions retain native Host behavior and native fallbacks. At most one successful target allocation commit per measured episode; no future output length or dual branch execution.
